role: CH10 content/interaction authority downstream of CH03/04/05/06/07/08 and upstream of CH11

operational_behavior.NORMAL: content may use its allowed depth
operational_behavior.DEGRADED: reduce load / shorten prompt / preserve route + return
operational_behavior.UNKNOWN: fail closed; do not imply availability

prompt_media_gate.rule: Every noun, relation and action demanded by a prompt must be directly perceivable or explicitly marked inference/unknown.
invalid_repairs: generic landscape substituted for site evidence

memory_rule: Trip output is the subset actually noticed; unread/closed pages remain blank rather than failed.
